memoryAid.coreFact: The pelvic brim where the ureter crosses the iliac vessels is a common ureteric-stone impaction site.

evidence.externalFinding: NCBI identifies the pelvic brim, along with UPJ and UVJ, as a common ureteric-stone impaction site.
